rationale: 8 of 9 rubric.md Phase 2 tables use the plain Finding|Score shape; the Learning Test modifier table Option B cites as precedent is status-driven, not count-driven, weakening the analogy; Phase 3's hard-override mechanism reads independent shell variables regardless of table shape, so no downstream constraint favors a separate modifier table.
rule: Option A — inline Criterion 4 deduction rows in rubric.md's Finding|Score table
alternatives_rejected: Option B — separate Target Status|Score Modifier|Action modifier table mirroring the Learning Test precedent
